reviews.t: Great quality tights, not great compression.
reviews.x: When I first opened these tights I was impressed by the quality of the product. They are thick and well-knitted on top and even provide great tummy support. I purchased them for the compression, however, and these did not work for me at all. I work retail and am on my feet all day with bad circulation, and I wear support hose to relieve the swelling and leg pain. On the second day of wearing these to work, I came home with sore ankles and achy legs. I then decided to go back to the 10-15mm Hg su

I've never used compression pantyhose before however, since I've had sclerotherapy, it was highly recommended. Therefore, after reading the rest of the reviews i decided to order these and they are awesome. They are very comfortable overall and hold in your stomach. I highly recommend these. I will be ordering more in different colors in the near future.
My only complaint is that these tights rip very easy. They do add a light support and are very comfortable but break apart easily especially in the buttock area.
Compression is helpful for tired legs and to flatten stomach. I'm 5'1" so the legs are a little bit longer than I would like. Overall both black and nude are excellent.

I gave 4 stars instead of 5 because they are way too long and to get the proper fit I have to wear the ankle part around my toes.  Which can be a little uncomfortable in tighter fitting shoes. They will definitely keep you warmer in the winter. And are relatively easy to get on considering how hard it is to get compression pantyhose on.

Love the light compression, slight sheen, and the silky feel of the fabric. I originally bought the 8-15 mmHg, however needed a higher compression, as I suffered from really bad edema during my pregnancy. These are so comfortable, that I continue to wear them months after my pregnancy, even after my edema went away

reviews.t: Save your money.  Not worth two cents!
reviews.x: Rips so easy’ I for the for after a surgery I had.  I wore them two days and they started getting holes and ripping.  I honestly thought after reading the description they would be better quality!

I have several pairs, and I wear them daily since early 2021.  I get leg swelling with lower leg edema.  I like this brand because it has a nice butt lift feature too.  I also love this brand because it doesn't make my thighs puff out under the upper ribbed support.  They have been comfortable for me to wear daily! I'm female, 5'5", 125-130lbs; I've been wearing their size small/medium.  Cons, but honestly it doesn't keep me from buying these stockings.  I have a few pairs, the older ones, with
Supportive for my needs. Varicose veins and recent weight loss these provide comfortable support. I work in a medical clinic and I am on my fret 80% of my day.

THE SWELLING WENT DOWN THE FIRST DAY I WORE THEM. I LIKE THIS STYLE BECAUSE YOU CAN WEAR SANDALS OR OPEN TOE SHOES. THEY WERE NOT TOO TIGHT, JUST RIGHT TO WEAR ALL DAY . I EVEN WEAR THEM ON HOT SUMMER DAYS, THEY REALLY HELP WITH CIRCULATION.

I got these looking for medical quality support hose. I'm post severe DVT and aortic artery emboli. My leg kept swelling. My concern is that once swelling develops and remains, the chances of it becoming permanent is high. These definitely give good compression. I'm building up my tolerance for wearing them. Doing several hours a day for 3 days, I noticed that my calf and thigh was normal size. The hose wash well in washer and dryer.  I use a mesh bag for them. These hose are made of a material
not medical at all, just top control. The fabric is of good quality but no calf or  leg compression

I had a 4 hour flight and wanted to prevent blood clots. These compression leggings were very comfortable, functional and stylish. I put them with a tunic as if I would with a regular pair of leggings. My health is in tact. They were pretty easy to put on.

WOW I have horrible varicose veins these are perfect, sizing is right on as well as great support. I would recommend these to anyone who have to wear support stockings. These are not sheer they are more a legging which makes them more versatile

reviews.t: Good quality but not as strong compression as I expected
reviews.x: Good quality but not as strong compression as I expected. Very long, if you are short these may be a bit too long

What on earth? If I could give a negative star I would.  There is no compression. I bought a small medium. I promise you I am large enough to wear a small / medium and it should totally compress-(I wear a size 6/8 in clothing.) however I am 52 not 6 foot 12 which is what the height should be for the person wearing these ridiculously long stockings. If anyone On here posted that they Find these stockings compression worthy-Then they’ve either been paid by the company, Or they Purchased a pair 3 s

I was hesitant to wear these all day because I thought they might make my ankles swell, but they have not. They are shiny, though, so if you’re going to wear as leggings you should know. I did try wearing them inside out and like the matte finish better. But, beware when putting these on; I have somehow already snagged them and, sadly, am not sure how I did so.

I returned to buy these in a bunch more colors after getting my first pair. I love how soft they feel. Plus they smooth everything out nicely. The way the waist is designed it’s smooth and doesn’t give me that dreaded muffin top. These will be especially fantastic during fall and winter to wear with knee high boots and a sweater dress.

reviews.t: Never got a chance to try them on
reviews.x: I just got these yesterday. I bought a medium/large size and when I tried to put them on for the first time they ripped! It wasn't a fingernail that did it either. It was like the material has a weak spot. I'm a size 4-6 so it's not like I bought a pair that may have been you small.

reviews.t: Good compression, rips after a lot of consecutive use
reviews.x: I’ve bought about 5-6 pairs of these (for medical reasons) and they work very well, they’re a tad long but I’m 19 years old and 5’3” with shorter legs. After a while they do start to rip, I’ve had to get rid of a pair due to this.
It's nice and smooth could be worn under dresses skirts but did not give any support
These are great compression hose. Nice to have the open toe!

I'm 5'5", 120 pounds, and bought these and tighter ones to compare. The tighter ones were so tight they causes bruises on the back of my knees. These were tight enough to give my circulation support but not too tight. They've lasted a year so far.  Treat gently as these are not TEDs stockings but do look sexier than TEDs below the upper thighs!  Love them so much I bought another pair and I plan to buy more (I hope there will be a sale!) soon in case this business closes one day which would be t

Top quality and fits perfect!  I've purchased other compression stockings from other companies in the past and nothing measures up to these.  I will definitely purchase more in the future.  I have worn them a full day the fit is very comfortable.  I am able wear these under dresses and skirts as the black is opaque and they look just like a typical tights.

reviews.t: I purchased these back in 2018, now they are not the same material.
reviews.x: Hi sellers, is there any way you guys have the style you had back in 2018? I suffer from varicose veins and these are the only one that ever seamed to help me. They hare all torn now from all the use. I ordered a pair couple months back but the material was totally different. Please contact me if you do or can do something.  Thank you!

claims.text: Many reviewers find the tights comfortable and supportive, especially for swelling, varicose veins, and all-day wear.
Several reviewers say the compression is weaker than expected or not medical-grade, with some noting it mainly controls the stomach rather than the legs.
A common complaint is that the tights are too long, particularly for shorter wearers.
Multiple reviewers report that the tights rip or develop holes easily.
Reviewers praise the fabric quality, describing it as thick, well-knitted, and silky.
